book.name: Malaka
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Malaka byex o

content: Vex ti taw wel lek Yesu nanghei Betani

Bouk yuw nanghei di yeip zeyi mata ngandoung wei Pasova me mata wei Yaeing Belet Wei Yis Ma Veil o. Om xel lumuki leitata me xel putoung wei petieing eno xel di yimexe sakwaing en xel embei zeimaxoun Yesu xupekeing dom nyeis e mey.
En xel neil, “Xey ambei se bong ambei nye lek bouk ngandoung wei lalo yo, enok xel xomaxoneing ne na neilama de vevek qandi lek.”

Ka Yesu la eivek beyeeng Betani, me la toundei eivek Simon beeng, tambiy yon takwei eno qou vanei lepa me di ya lek zek, de vex ti lam is botol qakous wei wel xeimangou wei malew ngandoung o, me lam dembu botol qakous on dom taw wel lek Yesu lu.
Xel valu wei toundei inyon eno yei tiyon om xel laleind wo nol me luk ngenong wouma, “Nambei nya ekom vex ne wo nol wou wel ne?
Wel tine teyeimbei xey a bong vateivek lek me na qou malew selewa teyei lek xouveing wei vakovek qes ti yo de na bong wou xel kanyo.” De xel neil vex on.
Yesu neil, “Nambei nya xam ghe wong nimaying wou vex ne? Xam wong e toundei, vex ne wong lul nimza ne wou ay.
Xel wei kanyo eno tyek na mi mendei is xam takwei takwei, om xam a mi devind xel taxombouk teyei lek ingwei xam ambei bong o. Dom ay ne tyek a se mendei is xam taxombouk.
Lul vati wei vex on teyeimbei bong eno e wong woy de taw wel lek a neing atax en menyex wou aning meyeing en eveing.
A neil wou xam zonghek, xel embei mi neil Xoulek Nimza nanghei inyayeiw eivek tembuing sapa eno tyek xel a mi tul pavulek en vati wei vex ne wong wou a ne, eno tyek xel a mi bou naleind en e.”
Woyom Yudas Iskariot, Yesu xe betiyeing xoumeeng yuw eno ti, la wou xel lumuki leitata me neil e teyei wou xel bei tyek na toung Yesu na eivek xel memend.
Xel ngo qayeeng tiwei Yudas neil ne om xel wo xeindlala. Me neil zonghek wou e bei tyek xel bong malew valu wou e. Om di yimexe sakwaing wei embei toung Yesu na eivek xel memend o.
Tambiy Ngandoung xe yaeing

Lek bouk tiwei tax wei Bouk Wei Yaeing Belet Wei Yis Ma Veil eno lam. Om xel betiwou kwa wei xel mi leis sipsip lingheing en yaeing lek bouk wei Pasova yo, eno xel betiyeing neil wou Yesu bei, “Wambei xa na menyex wou mata wei bouk Pasova nanghei tina en kandek wang na gwa eivek?”
Woyom Yesu wong xel betiyeing yuw la, me neil wou luw ambei nye, “Muw ghe na eivek Yerusalem nei. Moux ti tyek qalei deng mouing is memiing me nam pelong muw, ond muw betiwou e.
De muw a neil wou xomek ma tiwei embei deivek na yo bei, ‘Putoung teling, “A xe xomek lalei toundei inya, wei ambei gha yaeing wei bouk Pasova yo is a xe xel betiyeing ne yo?”’
Moxo tyek talex xomek lalei ngandoung nge wei di yeip gheyapu eno wou muw, me lulul wei yaeing lek o me deing lek eno xel menyex wou woy. Muw menyex wou lulul yaeing wou xey anghei inyon.”
Betiyeing aluw la, me la eivek beyeeng on me yei lul dalus e la teyei lek ambei kawei Yesu neil wou luw o. Om luw menyex wou mata wei bouk Pasova yo nanghei inyon.
Gyeik ingwei bouk eivek eno Yesu lam tyip is e xe xel betiyeing xoumeeng yuw.
Ka xel toundei lek lelek me di ya, moxo neil, “A neil wou xam zonghek bei, tyek xam ti venaxow na neil a teyei me na toung ay eivek xel ba memend, tambiy tiwei di ya yaeing is a ne.”
Moxoyeiw laleind wo nimaying, om xel titi di teling wou e, “Beip inye se ay, ei?”
Moxo neil elox, “Xam xoumeeng yuw on ti, tiwei di ya belet lek dipek is ay ne.

Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek betiwou sakwaing kawei xel byex eivek xoulek wei Anutu en e yo. Ekom inye wo lalei pyaweing en tambiy tiwei embei neil Xomaxoneing Neu Moux teyei me na toung e na eivek xel ba memend o, eno tyek na qou myaveweeng ghanaw veil. Om inye nimza bei moux tiyon ta se bou e.”
Ka xel di ya, Yesu qou belet, me wong dange wou dom dembu, me wong wou e xe xel betiyeing, me neil, “Xam qou, tine inye a neing.”
Woyom moxo qou mayamya wain, me wong dange wou dom wong wou xel, me xel dalus num eivek.
Yesu neil wou xel, “Tine inye a xe gyand wei na byexaxoun qokatu yo, wei a qapyex bei devind xomaxoneing ngenong o.
A neil wou xam zonghek, tyek a se nox me na num wain neing no qe ka gyeik bouk wei a num wain vako eivek tete lalei wei Anutu yo.”
Gyeik xel wong lalo ti woy, xel la myayaing me la lukendu Oliv.
Yesu neil atax bei Petele tyek dax e vun
Yesu neil wou xel, “Xam dalus xe wongeingis tyek detei veil en xel byex eivek xoulek wei Anutu yo eno nambei nye:

content.text: “ ‘Tyek a nyeis gyovaxa wei sipsip o,
dom tyek sipsip na pek me davuna.’ Sakarias 13:7

content: Ekom ka a qandi lek veil meyeing le, tyek a na tax en xam me nana Galili.”
Petele neilteyei, “Wangwei xel dalus xe wongeingis detei veil me xel na veil wang, on tyek a se teyeimbei na veil wang.”
Yesu lewexe, “A neil zonghek wou wang, gweimbeeng boukeing wei qouklex seng ghei sesa vya luyuw eno tyek wamaxow ghe dax a vun luyal.”
Ekom Petele nale nikanzek en qayeeng me neil wou Yesu, “Ma mouyo wangwei a mey is wang nei on tyek a se teyeimbei dax wang vun!” Me xel betiyeing dalus neil ambei nyon teyeima.
Yesu la zeimema nanghei Getsemani
Xel la beyeeng ti lei bei Getsemani, me Yesu neil wou e xe xel betiyeing, “Xam a toumendei inye dom a na zeimemang.”
Om Yesu qou Petele luw Jems me Yoan me lal la is e, ekom moxo axe nimaying ngandoung me lalei wo nimaying.
Yesu neil wou xel, “A axe nimaying ngandoung lek xow teyeimbei a mey. Mal a toumendei inye me ghe gweiteyei teyei embo nimza.”
Yesu dula nayaka, de teila yeip ma eivek tembuing dom zeimema bei wangwei inye teyei nei ond nimaying ne deteina veil e.
Moxo neil, “Aba, Mang, lulul sapa yon teyeimbei wang bong. Zeim mayamya tine veil ay. Ekom wa se betiwou a laleing, qe wa betiwou wamaxow laleim.”
Woyom Yesu loumelam wou e xe betiyeing a lal me yei lal di yeip. E neil wou Petele, “Simon, wa ghei di weip? Inye se teyeimbei wam di gweina nayaka, ei?
Om mal mendi gweiteyei teyei me na zeimemamim en kandek mal se detei en axeing. Xam laleimim embei bong xuk, ekom neing wo nimaing.”
Lox me la lunge no me zeimema nambei nge tax o.
Gyeik e loumelam, e yei lal lox me la yeip no, en nambei lal mendghalus wo nimaying. Om lal se wou naleind en vati wei lal embei neil wou e yo.

Yesu loumelam tiwei luyal o, dom neil wou lal, “Mal anghei di weip me ghe qou laweeng. Woy, seivma lam o. Wei, Xomaxoneing Neu Moux xel embei neil e teyei me na toung e na eivek xel wei sewokeing o memend.
Mal qandi lek! Me xey a la! Wei, tiwei embei neil a teyei me na toung a na eivek xel memend eno lam tyip on!”
Xel zeimaxoun Yesu

Ka Yesu nanghei di neil qayeeng, Yudas wei betiyeing xoumeeng yuw eno ti lam tyip is xel qendu ngandoung on, xel zeim ngeyeing vevek me pebumeeng, xel lumuki leitata, me putoung wei petieing o me xel teivateiv eno wong xel lam.

Tambiy tiwei embei neil Yesu teyei me na toung e na eivek xel vevek memend eno talex dee ti wou xel bei, “Tambiy tiwei ambei sesuvexe eno, tiyo inyon, om xam a zeimaxoun e me ghe gweiteyei de na qou e me na.”
Yudas lam me la daing wou Yesu me neil wou bei, “Putoung!” Dom sesuvexe e.
Om xel xomaxoneing on zeimaxoun Yesu.
Woyom xel wei toungale paviy yon ti tetei e xe ngeyeing vevek me qateiv xukxe wei lumuki lukanzek on nenyalis nge tip me teila.
Yesu neil wou xel, “Xam ambei a panaxana ti, om xam ghe lam is ngeyeing vevek me pebumeeng bei nam a zeimaxoun a ne?
Teyei lek bouk tambak eno a mindei is xam, me na wo teyoxeing eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o, ekom xam seng zeimaxoun ay. En qayeeng wei yeip eivek Anutu xe xoulek eno embo neing lek.”
Woyom xel betiyeing dalus ghanaw e de pek me la.
Xomaxoneing ghavis ti, se byex lulti qe teimb teleing ti wei sevun xow eno ti, me di betiwou Yesu gyeik ingwei xel zeimaxoun e yo,
ekom moxo pek veil xel xeitouk me la dom ghanaw e xe teimb teleing on toundei yus.
Yesu nale wou xel kanzol mend
Xel qou Yesu me la wou lumuki lukanzek, de xel lumuki leitata dalus me teivateiv, me putoung wei petieing o xel xouing lam qekuma.
Petele di betiwou e me la kwanding, me la eivek tete lalei wei xomek wei lumuki lukanzek o, nanghei inyon eno la dei is xel belimbo wei mi yeiteyei xomek vambuing o me di pavang xow wou nenyex.
Xel lumuki leitata is xel kanzol dalus eno di yimexe pavulek wei e wong esewok o en ingwei xel embei nyeis e mey yo, ekom xel se yeiwou ti.
Xel ngenong byex qayeeng tyonyeing lek e, ekom xel xe qayeeng se la teyeima.
Woyom xel valu nale ghey me wong pavulek tyonyeing tine lek e:
“Xa ngo e neil, ‘Tyek a lelolexe xomek vambuing tine wei xomaxoneing ev ne dom eivek bouk yal eno tyek a dev nge no, wei xomaxoneing se ev angya memend o.’”
Ekom pavulek wei xel neil on la bandabanda de se teyeima.
Woyom lumuki lukanzek eno nale wou xel mend me teling Yesu, “Qayeeng vati ingwei xel moux tine di byex lek wang ne? Se teyeimbei wa neil qayeeng ti nox wou xel?”
Ekom Yesu toungale kanzek de se neil qayeeng ti lox. Lumuki lukanzek lox me la teling wou e no, “Inye wa Kilisi. Anutu wei xa mi sanghoxe yo neu, ei?”
Yesu neil, “Inye ay yo. Me tyek xam ghe gwei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux na toumendei wou Anutu Nikanzekta mema payeiv me nam is laxap wei tyoung gheyapu yo.”
Lumuki lukanzek lex emaxow xe teimb de teling, “Xey a ngo qayeeng wei xel valu byex lek e is en va?
Emaxow neil teyei me xam ghe ngo qayeeng lukeingyak wei neil lek Anutu yo. Om xam ghe wou naleimim ambei nya?” Xel dalus yei me luk en e bei, “Wo esewok teyei lek ingwei e mey yo.”

Woyom xel valu pesuv myend louk lek e, me xel tup e ma tuzeyi, de lund memend me venoux e me neil, “Neil qayeeng poropet wou xa bei eti leis wang!” Om xel belimbo wei mi yeiteyei xomek vambuing eno qou e me leis e.
Petele ax Yesu vun
Ka Petele toundei nge xo eivek tete lalei eno, lumuki lukanzek xe xukxe vexawo ti lam.
Gyeik vexo yei Petele di pavang xow wou nenyex, vexo yei e bombek me neil, “Wang is ambei nyon wang mi la is Yesu wei Nasaret o.”
Ekom Petele axvun. E neil, “A loungen e yo, a se woulek qayeeng tiwei wang di luklek on.” Dom la myayaing paviy tete mya me la nale. [De qouklex ti sesa vya.]
Gyeik vex xukxe yei e ghei inyon, vexo neil no wou xel wei toungale yon, “Tambiy tine inye tambiy wei xel o ti.”
Ekom moxo lox me la axvun no. Denlek ka, xel wei toungale paviyeing eno neil wou Petele, “Neing ayang wang on tambiy wei xel o ti, en inye wang lam anghei Galili.”
Petele neil, “A neil zonghek lek inyapunei lei bei a loung en tambiy tiwei xam ghe di luk en e yon. Wangwei a tyoing nei yon tyek a qou myaveweeng.”
Se denlek en qouklex sesa vya luyuw. Woyom Petele wounalei no en qayeeng wei Yesu neil woy wou e yo, “Ka qouklex se sesa vya bo luyuw atax eno tyek wang dax a vun luyal.” Om moxo eng niseikeing.
